mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_login_session ( id, user_id, grant_hash, session_version, created_at, last_used_at, idle_expires_at, absolute_expires_at, row_version ) VALUES ( UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}), UUID_TO_BIN(#{userId}), #{grantHash}, #{sessionVersion}, #{now}, #{now}, #{idleExpiresAt}, #{absoluteExpiresAt}, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT BIN_TO_UUID(login_session.id) AS session_id, BIN_TO_UUID(account.id) AS user_id, account.username, account.role, account.status, account.password_change_required, account.session_version, account.created_at AS user_created_at, account.updated_at AS user_updated_at, account.row_version AS user_row_version, login_session.idle_expires_at, login_session.absolute_expires_at, login_session.row_version FROM user_login_session AS login_session JOIN user_account AS account ON account.id = login_session.user_id WHERE login_session.grant_hash = #{grantHash} AND login_session.revoked_at IS NULL AND login_session.idle_expires_at > #{now} AND login_session.absolute_expires_at > #{now} AND login_session.session_version = account.session_version AND account.status = 'ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE user_login_session SET last_used_at = #{now}, idle_expires_at = LEAST(#{idleExpiresAt}, absolute_expires_at), row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{id}) AND revoked_at IS NULL AND row_version = #{expectedRowVersion}
UPDATE user_login_session SET revoked_at = #{now}, revoke_reason = #{reason}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE grant_hash = #{grantHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE user_login_session SET revoked_at = #{now}, revoke_reason = #{reason}, row_version = row_version + 1 WHERE user_id = UUID_TO_BIN(#{userId}) AND revoked_at IS NULL
